scripts.build:server: npm --prefix framerize-castle run build && npm run build --workspace=@framerize/core && tsc -p tsconfig.server-tools.json && node .tools/scripts/build-server.js && tsc -p framerize-server/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:server && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && npm run build --workspace=framerize-remote
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=@framerize/core && tsc -p framerize-server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && npm --prefix framerize-server run check && npm run typecheck --workspace=framerize-remote && npm --prefix framerize-castle run check
scripts.test: npm --prefix framerize-castle test && npm run test --workspace=@framerize/core && node --test .tools/test/core-package-check.test.js .tools/test/installed-server-flow.test.js .tools/test/installed-remote-flow.test.js .tools/test/installed-castle-flow.test.js && npm --prefix framerize-server test && npm run test --workspace=framerize-remote && npm run test:capacity
